'''Sergio Doplicher''' ({{IPA|it|ˈsɛrdʒo ˈdɔpliker|lang}};<ref>{{cite web |title=Ricordo di Sergio Doplicher |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMMXBA0v_1s |website=YouTube |access-date=15 September 2025}}</ref> 30 December 1940{{snd}}9 September 2025) was an Italian [[mathematical physicist]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aracneeditrice.it/aracneweb/index.php/autori.html?auth-id=sdrm1mt|title=Sergio Doplicher|website=Aracne editrice|language=it|access-date=15 February 2021}}</ref> who mainly dealt with the mathematical foundations of [[quantum field theory]] and [[quantum gravity]].

== Life and career ==
Sergio Doplicher was born on 30 December 1940 in [[Trieste]]<ref name=ilpiccolo>{{cite news |title=Addio al fisico triestino Doplicher, unì scienza e cultura umanistica |url=https://www.ilpiccolo.it/nordest/sergio-doplicher-morto-fisico-chi-era-w9228nyp |work=Il Piccolo |date=11 September 2025 |language=it}}</ref><ref name=lastampa>{{cite news |title=A Boves l'addio a Sergio Doplicher, gigante della fisica matematica |url=https://www.lastampa.it/cuneo/2025/09/10/news/a_boves_l_addio_a_sergio_doplicher_gigante_della_fisica_matematica-15303998/ |work=La Stampa |date=10 September 2025 |language=it}}</ref> and graduated in Physics at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]] in 1963 under the supervision of [[Giovanni Jona-Lasinio]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=100234}}.</ref> From 1976 to 2011 he was [[full professor]]<ref>More precisely, the Italian academic title is [[professore ordinario]] or ''professore di I fascia''.</ref> of [[quantum mechanics]] in the mathematics department of Sapienza University, retiring there in 2011 as [[professor emeritus]].<ref name=AcademiaEuropeaMain>{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Doplicher_Sergio|title=Doplicher's member page of Academia Europæa|website=Academia Europæa|access-date=17 February 2021}} {{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Doplicher_Sergio/CV|title=Sergio Doplicher − Curriculum Vitae|website=Academia Europæa|access-date=17 February 2021}}</ref>

He was known for his research based on the [[Haag–Kastler axioms]] and for his collaboration with [[Rudolf Haag]]. With John E. Roberts<ref>Doplicher coauthored several papers with Roberts, who worked for a long time in Rome.</ref> and Haag, he examined [[superselection|superselection rules]] in the [[algebraic quantum field theory]], providing the first proof of the [[spin–statistics theorem]] entirely based only on [[first principle]]s. Doplicher and Roberts also proved a reconstruction theorem for the algebra of [[quantum fields]] and the compact group of global internal symmetries from the algebra of the observables.<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Halvorson|first1=Hans|last2=Müger|first2=Michael|date=2007|editor1-last=Butterfield|editor1-first=Jeremy|editor2-last=Earman|editor2-first=John|article=Algebraic quantum field theory|title=Philosophy of Physics|pages=731–864|publisher=Elsevier B.V.|isbn=978-0-444-51560-5|doi=10.1016/B978-044451560-5/50011-7|arxiv=math-ph/0602036|s2cid=117677547}}</ref><ref>{{nlab|id=DHR+superselection+theory|title=DHR superselection theory}}.</ref> In other collaborations, Doplicher studied the local aspects of superselection rules. After introducing the split-property, he derived exact [[current algebra]]s and a weak form of a quantum [[Noether theorem]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Doplicher|first=Sergio|title=The Principle of Locality: Effectiveness, fate and challenges|journal=Journal of Mathematical Physics|volume=51|year=2010|issue=1|article-number=015218|doi=10.1063/1.3276100|arxiv=0911.5136|bibcode=2010JMP....51a5218D|s2cid=115160705}}</ref>

Later in his career, Doplicher dealt with the mathematical foundations of quantum gravity in terms
of the quantum structure of space-time at the [[Planck scale]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Doplicher|first1=Sergio|last2=Fredenhagen|first2=Klaus|last3=Roberts|first3=John E.|title=The Quantum structure of space-time at the Planck scale and quantum fields|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|volume=172|year=1995|issue=1|pages=187–220|doi=10.1007/BF02104515|arxiv=hep-th/0303037|bibcode=1995CMaPh.172..187D|s2cid=16206928|url=https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.cmp/1104273963}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last1=Bahns|first1=Dorothea|last2=Doplicher|first2=Sergio|last3=Morsella|first3=Gerardo|last4=Piacitelli|first4=Gherardo|date=2015|editor1-last=Brunetti|editor1-first=Romeo|editor2-last=Dappiaggi|editor2-first=Claudio|editor3-last=Fredenhagen|editor3-first=Klaus|editor4-last=Yngvason|editor4-first=Jakob|chapter=Quantum Spacetime and Algebraic Quantum Field Theory|title=Advances in algebraic quantum field theory|pages=289–330|publisher=Springer, Cham|isbn=978-3-319-21353-8|doi=10.1007/978-3-319-21353-8_7|arxiv=1501.03298|s2cid=118886773}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Doplicher|first=Sergio|title=Space-time and fields: A Quantum texture|journal=AIP Conference Proceedings|volume=589|number=1|year=2001|pages=204–213|doi=10.1063/1.1419326|arxiv=hep-th/0105251|bibcode=2001AIPC..589..204D|s2cid=16229759}}</ref> He also addressed the problem of measurement in [[local quantum physics]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Doplicher|first=Sergio|title=The Measurement Process in Local Quantum Physics and the EPR Paradox|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|volume=357|year=2018|issue=1|pages=407–420|doi=10.1007/s00220-017-2949-z|arxiv=0908.0480|bibcode=2018CMaPh.357..407D|s2cid=16610103}}</ref>

He was the author of the first article of the first number of the scientific journal ''[[Communications in Mathematical Physics]]''.<ref>{{cite journal|last=Doplicher|first=Sergio|title=An algebraic spectrum condition|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics|volume=1|year=1965|issue=1|pages=1–5|doi=10.1007/BF01649586|bibcode=1965CMaPh...1....1D|s2cid=122004464|url=https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.cmp/1103757611}}</ref>

Doplicher died in [[Boves, Piedmont|Boves]] on 9 September 2025,<ref name=laguida>{{cite news |last1=Campagna |first1=Marco |title=Boves piange il professor Sergio Doplicher |url=https://laguida.it/2025/09/10/boves-pia-al-professor-sergio-doplicher/ |work=La Guida |date=10 September 2025 |language=it}}</ref> at the age of 84.<ref name=ilpiccolo /><ref name=lastampa />

== Honours and awards ==
Doplicher was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Kyoto in 1990.<ref>{{cite book|author=Doplicher, Sergio|title=''In:'' Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, Kyoto, 1990|chapter=Abstract compact group duals, operator algebras and quantum field theory|volume=1|pages=1319–1333|year=1990}}</ref> He was awarded in 2004 the [[Humboldt Prize]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview?tx_rsmavhsolr_solrview%5BpPersonId%5D=1115764&cHash=f26f41e2d6cfb89bd45261ee34c9617e|title=Humboldt Foundation member page of Sergio Doplicher|website=humboldt-foundation.de|access-date=15 February 2021}}</ref> and in 2011 the Italian National Prize ''Presidente della Repubblica'' of the [[Lincei National Academy]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lincei.it/it/premi-presidente-della-repubblica-1949-2011|title=Premi Presidente della Repubblica 1949–2011|language=it|website=Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei|access-date=15 February 2021}}</ref> In 2013 he was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi#d|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|website=American Mathematical Society|access-date=15 February 2021}} {{cite journal|last=Jackson|first=Allyn|title=Fellows of the AMS: Inaugural Class|journal=Notices of the AMS|volume=60|number=5|year=2013|pages=631–637|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/rnoti-p631.pdf}}</ref> and in 2019 a member of the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref name=AcademiaEuropeaMain/>
